title: Tanvi Sharma Advances to Vietnam Open Quarterfinals
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma continues her impressive run at an international event.
summary: India's Tanvi Sharma defeated Thailand's Passa-Orn Phannachet in straight games to secure a spot in the Vietnam Open 2026 women's singles quarterfinals.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course signifies BAI's commitment to enhancing coaching standards across India, directly impacting future player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India will host a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for 2026 Inter State Team Championships
indian_angle: New regulations for the Inter State Team Championships will shape competition for Indian teams nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and eligibility for the domestic event.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pair for the World Junior Championships selection trials impacts India's representation at the global event.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's U17 and U15 junior teams for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior teams for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
